The car engine is leaking oil. Regularly, every 2.5 s, a drop of oil hits the road.

parts.label: a
parts.text: The car is driven at a steady speed of 10 m/s through the town.

parts.label: i
parts.text:
Calculate the distance on the road between one oil drop and the next oil drop.
distance between oil drops = ................... m[2]

parts.text:
The town is 500 m across. Show that it takes the car 50 s to travel through the
town.

parts.label: b
parts.text:
At a distance of 1000 m outside the town, the car passes a tree. At a further distance of
1500 m, the car passes a pylon. Between the tree and the pylon the oil drops are all
75 m apart.
Calculate the speed of the car between the tree and the pylon.
speed of car = ................ m/s[2]

The car has travelled at constant speed.
